$comment: Explicit operator approvals for D1 migrations that the release pipeline will not
apply automatically. The gate classifies every pending migration; anything it cannot
prove additive is blocked unless an entry here matches the database, the exact file
name, and the SHA-256 of the file's content (node scripts/ci/migration-gate.mjs
--print-hash <file>). Editing an approved file invalidates its approval, so an
approval can never cover unreviewed SQL. Every entry needs database, file, sha256,
reason, approved_by, and approved_at. See docs/CI-CD.md for the review checklist.
